terms.gloss: watercolours, the paints; literally watered colours
evidence: M-O s.v. watercolor: imāgō aquātīs colōribus picta (Lexicon Recentis Latinitatis)
Levi–Bini p. 2: tabula colōribus dīlūtīs (aquātīs) dēlīneāta, a watercolour
terms.comment: The modern books’ phrase, built on the classical aquātus, mixed with water, thin (Plin. NH 28.124, of milk).

evidence: Levi–Bini p. 2: colōre dīlūtō dēlīneāre, to paint in watercolour

phrases.latin: Colōribus aquātīs pingāmus: affer aquam et pēnicillum.
phrases.english: Let’s paint with watercolours: bring the water and a brush.

phrases.latin: Pēnicillum ēlue antequam alium colōrem sūmās.
phrases.english: Rinse the brush before you take another colour.

sources: Lewis & Short: aquatus · Lewis & Short: color · Lewis & Short: diluo
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. watercolor.
Enrico Levi and Arturo Bini, Il latino come lingua viva (1937), p. 2, s.v. acquarello.
